items.title: createPriceListPricesStep
items.description: This step creates prices for a price list.

items.title: createPriceListsStep
items.description: This step creates a price list.

items.title: deletePriceListsStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more price lists.

items.title: getExistingPriceListsPriceIdsStep
items.description: This step retrieves prices of price lists.

items.title: updatePriceListPricesStep
items.description: This step updates a price list's prices.

items.title: updatePriceListsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more price lists.

items.title: validatePriceListsStep
items.description:
This step validates that the specified price lists exist.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

items.title: validateVariantPriceLinksStep
items.description:
This step validates that the specified variants have prices.
If not valid, the step throws an error.
